listing.name: Pokémon Colosseum — Colosseum_Recomp (grant-might)
listing.summary: Upstream documents a build-and-play route, naming-screen text and widescreen fixes and intro-overlay behavior. It does not claim a complete playthrough. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Pokémon Colosseum GC6E01 disc image. The supplied build normally uses ISO. Its picker also lists WBFS and RVZ, but this guide has not confirmed those formats. Setup uses extracted files and 168 REL overlays; the generated module is not included.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the project’s complete colosseum-launcher-2.zip, including its launcher, runner, app-local MSVC libraries and two offline component archives with pinned hashes. On first run it extracts your own disc, generates C code and compiles a local DLL cached by DOL hash. That first-run setup needs no network connection.

warnings: Upstream documents a build-and-play route, naming-screen text and widescreen fixes and intro-overlay behavior. It does not claim a complete playthrough.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
